subject.title: [Security] Lack of rate limiting on custom channel reactions in status notifications

question: Does the reporter have enough concrete evidence to identify a reachable client-controlled reaction path, or should this be redirected to a new private security report with an exact WebSocket transcript?
rationale: Current source contradicts the named path, but a security-sensitive availability claim should not be dismissed without giving the reporter a precise evidence request.

options.title: Request exact reproduction
options.body: Ask for the channel or plugin, client role and scopes, WebSocket method and redacted parameters, sustained request rate, and before-and-after memory, event-loop, and queue measurements.

options.title: Close as unverified
options.body: Close if no callable method or current-main trace can be supplied, inviting a new private report with reproducible evidence.

recommendation.title: Request exact reproduction
recommendation.body: Ask for the channel or plugin, client role and scopes, WebSocket method and redacted parameters, sustained request rate, and before-and-after memory, event-loop, and queue measurements.
